          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. On create, the value is
            normalized to E.164 form: a leading '+' and country code are kept
            when present, otherwise country code '+61' is assumed and a single
            leading '0' is dropped from the national digits; spaces, dashes and
            brackets are stripped. The result must have 8 to 15 digits after the
            '+'.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: >-
            The optional email address of the pet owner. When present it must be
            a syntactically valid address; it is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'george.franklin@example.com'
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            The optional 4-digit postcode of the pet owner. When present it must be
            valid for the owner's city per a fixed region table (Sydney/NSW
            2000-2099, Melbourne/VIC 3000-3099, Brisbane/QLD 4000-4099); a city with
            no known region accepts any 4-digit postcode. Stored and returned when
            given.
          type: string
          example: '2000'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the pet owner was registered, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
            Optional on create; when omitted the server sets it to its current
            date.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: >-
            The optional date of birth of the pet owner, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD'
            format. When present it drives the derived 'ageBand'.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            Create-only flag. The householdId is always derived automatically from
            the last name and postcode, so owners sharing those already share a
            household. When true, this flag only bypasses the duplicate block: the
            owner is created as a declared household member even though another owner
            is already in the same household (same last name and postcode, for
            example family members living together), and it is not flagged as a
            possible duplicate. Defaults to false.
          type: boolean
          default: false
          writeOnly: true
          example: false

        - firstName

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. On create, the value is
            normalized to E.164 form: a leading '+' and country code are kept
            when present, otherwise country code '+61' is assumed and a single
            leading '0' is dropped from the national digits; spaces, dashes and
            brackets are stripped. The result must have 8 to 15 digits after the
            '+'.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: >-
            The optional email address of the pet owner. When present it must be
            a syntactically valid address; it is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'george.franklin@example.com'
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            The optional 4-digit postcode of the pet owner. When present it must be
            valid for the owner's city per a fixed region table (Sydney/NSW
            2000-2099, Melbourne/VIC 3000-3099, Brisbane/QLD 4000-4099); a city with
            no known region accepts any 4-digit postcode. Stored and returned when
            given.
          type: string
          example: '2000'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the pet owner was registered, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
            Optional on create; when omitted the server sets it to its current
            date.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: >-
            The optional date of birth of the pet owner, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD'
            format. When present it drives the derived 'ageBand'.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            Create-only flag. The householdId is always derived automatically from
            the last name and postcode, so owners sharing those already share a
            household. When true, this flag only bypasses the duplicate block: the
            owner is created as a declared household member even though another owner
            is already in the same household (same last name and postcode, for
            example family members living together), and it is not flagged as a
            possible duplicate. Defaults to false.
          type: boolean
          default: false
          writeOnly: true
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone display
              description: >-
                The stored E.164 'telephone' formatted for humans: a '+' and the
                country code, a space, then the national digits grouped in threes
                (e.g. '+61412345678' -> '+61 412 345 678'). Raw 'telephone' stays
                in E.164 form.
              type: string
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: >-
                The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName,
                dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: >-
                The owner's customer code, formatted '<REGION>-<HASH8>' where
                REGION is the region the owner's postcode derives to (falling
                back to the city table when the postcode is absent or in no known
                range) and HASH8 is the first eight upper-case hex characters of
                the SHA-256 digest of the normalized telephone concatenated with
                the last name. Assigned at creation.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW-1A2B3C4D'
              readOnly: true
            checkDigit:
              title: Check digit
              description: >-
                A single Luhn check digit (0-9) computed over the digit
                characters of the owner's customerCode.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              maximum: 9
              example: 4
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                A stable identifier shared by owners that live in the same
                household, derived deterministically as the first 12 upper-case
                hex characters of the SHA-256 digest of the normalized last name,
                a '|' separator and the postcode. Any two owners with the same
                last name and postcode therefore carry the same value
                automatically, regardless of creation order. Absent for owners
                created without a postcode.
              type: string
              example: 'A1B2C3D4E5F6'
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: >-
                The owner's derived duplicate-detection key, formed at read time
                as normalizedTelephone + '|' + (email or empty) + '|' +
                (householdId or empty). Two owners are duplicates only when their
                whole identityKey is equal; a create whose identityKey matches an
                existing owner's is rejected with 409.
              type: string
              example: '+61412345678||A1B2C3D4E5F6'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of owners that already existed at the time this owner
                was created sharing the same first name and last name, compared
                case-insensitively.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: >-
                The owner's membership number, formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>'
                where YY is the last two digits of the registrationDate year.
                Assigned at creation.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW-1A2B3C4D-M26'
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: >-
                Flag captured at creation time: true when more than 80 owners
                had already been created for the same day at the time this owner
                was created, otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points

                The owner's membership points, assigned at creation starting at 0:
                plus 2 when an email is present, plus 1 when namesakeCount is 0, plus
                2 for a household of 3 or more, plus 3 for tenure over 365 days.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: >-
                The owner's membership level, derived at creation from

            locality:

                the customerCode (the portion before the first '-'), so it shares

            timezone:

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: >-
            The postal address of the pet owner. Accepted as a flat input for
            backward compatibility; when the structured 'addressLine1' (and
            optional 'addressLine2') is supplied it is preferred. On read this is
            the composed, normalized address: the normalized 'addressLine1', with
            a single space and the normalized 'addressLine2' appended when
            present.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: >-
            The first line of the structured postal address. Preferred over the
            flat 'address' when supplied. Normalized like 'address' on create.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: >-
            The optional second line of the structured postal address. When
            present it is normalized and appended to 'addressLine1' in the
            composed 'address'.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Apt 4'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. On create, the value is
            normalized to E.164 form: a leading '+' and country code are kept
            when present, otherwise country code '+61' is assumed and a single
            leading '0' is dropped from the national digits; spaces, dashes and
            brackets are stripped. The result must have 8 to 15 digits after the
            '+'.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: >-
            The optional email address of the pet owner. When present it must be
            a syntactically valid address; it is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'george.franklin@example.com'
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            The optional 4-digit postcode of the pet owner. When present it must be
            valid for the owner's city per a fixed region table (Sydney/NSW
            2000-2099, Melbourne/VIC 3000-3099, Brisbane/QLD 4000-4099); a city with
            no known region accepts any 4-digit postcode. Stored and returned when
            given.
          type: string
          example: '2000'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the pet owner was registered, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
            Optional on create; when omitted the server sets it to its current
            date.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: >-
            The optional date of birth of the pet owner, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD'
            format. When present it drives the derived 'ageBand'.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            Create-only flag. The householdId is always derived automatically from
            the last name and postcode, so owners sharing those already share a
            household. When true, this flag only bypasses the duplicate block: the
            owner is created as a declared household member even though another owner
            is already in the same household (same last name and postcode, for
            example family members living together), and it is not flagged as a
            possible duplicate. Defaults to false.
          type: boolean
          default: false
          writeOnly: true
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone display
              description: >-
                The stored E.164 'telephone' formatted for humans: a '+' and the
                country code, a space, then the national digits grouped in threes
                (e.g. '+61412345678' -> '+61 412 345 678'). Raw 'telephone' stays
                in E.164 form.
              type: string
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: >-
                The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName,
                dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: >-
                The owner's customer code, formatted '<REGION>-<HASH8>' where
                REGION is the region the owner's postcode derives to (falling
                back to the city table when the postcode is absent or in no known
                range) and HASH8 is the first eight upper-case hex characters of
                the SHA-256 digest of the normalized telephone concatenated with
                the last name. Assigned at creation.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW-1A2B3C4D'
              readOnly: true
            checkDigit:
              title: Check digit
              description: >-
                A single Luhn check digit (0-9) computed over the digit
                characters of the owner's customerCode.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              maximum: 9
              example: 4
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                A stable identifier shared by owners that live in the same
                household, derived deterministically as the first 12 upper-case
                hex characters of the SHA-256 digest of the normalized last name,
                a '|' separator and the postcode. Any two owners with the same
                last name and postcode therefore carry the same value
                automatically, regardless of creation order. Absent for owners
                created without a postcode.
              type: string
              example: 'A1B2C3D4E5F6'
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: >-
                The owner's derived duplicate-detection key, formed at read time
                as normalizedTelephone + '|' + (email or empty) + '|' +
                (householdId or empty). Two owners are duplicates only when their
                whole identityKey is equal; a create whose identityKey matches an
                existing owner's is rejected with 409.
              type: string
              example: '+61412345678||A1B2C3D4E5F6'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of owners that already existed at the time this owner
                was created sharing the same first name and last name, compared
                case-insensitively.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: >-
                The owner's membership number, formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>'
                where YY is the last two digits of the registrationDate year.
                Assigned at creation.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW-1A2B3C4D-M26'
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: >-
                Flag captured at creation time: true when more than 80 owners
                had already been created for the same day at the time this owner
                was created, otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: >-
                The owner's membership points, assigned at creation starting at 0:
                plus 2 when an email is present, plus 1 when namesakeCount is 0, plus
                2 for a household of 3 or more, plus 3 for tenure over 365 days.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: >-
                The owner's membership level, derived at creation from
                membershipPoints: 1 for 0-1 points, 2 for 2-3, 3 for 4-5, and 4 for
                6 or more points.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The owner's region, read at read time from the REGION segment of
                the customerCode (the portion before the first '-'), so it shares
                the single region-and-hash identity assigned at creation.
                'UNKNOWN' when no region can be resolved.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: >-
                The owner's IANA timezone, derived at read time from the
                locality/region via a fixed region-to-timezone table:
                NSW->Australia/Sydney, VIC->Australia/Melbourne,
                QLD->Australia/Brisbane. Absent when no region can be resolved.
              type: string
              example: 'Australia/Sydney'
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: >-
                The owner's preferred contact channel, derived at read time:
                'EMAIL' when an email is present, otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: >-
                The owner's age band, derived at read time from 'birthDate'
                against 'registrationDate': 'MINOR' when under 18, 'ADULT' from
                18 to 64, 'SENIOR' at 65 or over. Absent when no birthDate is
                given.
              type: string
              example: 'ADULT'
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate
              description: >-
                Flag captured at creation time: true when the owner is not a hard
                duplicate but shares an existing owner's last name and postcode
                while carrying a different telephone, otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicateOf:
              title: Possible duplicate of
              description: >-
                The id of the existing owner this owner is a possible duplicate of,
                captured at creation time. Present only when 'possibleDuplicate' is
                true.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - pets

1. **`src/main/resources/openapi.yml`** — Added `addressLine1` and `addressLine2` properties to the `OwnerFields` schema (so they appear on both request and response), and removed `address` from the `required` list (an owner can now supply its address structurally, so `address` is validated in the controller rather than at binding time). `city` remains required.

2. **`model/Owner.java`** — Added `addressLine1`/`addressLine2` fields (mapped to `address_line1`/`address_line2` columns) with getters/setters.

3. **DB schemas** (`hsqldb`, `h2`, `mysql`, `postgres`) — Added the `address_line1`/`address_line2` columns to the `owners` table.

4. **`OwnerRestControllerV1.java`** — Rewrote `normalizeAddress` to canonicalize whichever address fields are supplied (structured lines and/or flat address), write the normalized `addressLine1`/`addressLine2` back, and compose the returned `address`:
   - When `addressLine1` is present: `address` = normalized `addressLine1`, with a single space and normalized `addressLine2` appended when `addressLine2` is present.
   - Otherwise it falls back to the normalized flat `address`.
   
   Because the composed value is written into the DTO's `address` field before validation, the existing required-field check rejects an owner supplying neither form, and everything downstream that reads the address (persistence/response, plus city/postcode-driven household hash, postcode validation and locality) sees the effective address — structured when present, flat otherwise. Applied the same normalization/composition to `updateOwner` for consistency.

**Test results:** `Tests run: 2, Failures: 0, Errors: 0` — `BUILD SUCCESS`. This covers the new structured-address normalization/composition test and the backward-compatible flat-address test.
